zh-Hant.title: 講完之後，點一下文字就複製
zh-Hant.body: 語音輸入完，點一下剛打出來的文字就能複製整段，鍵盤上方會顯示「✓ 已複製」。鍵盤也更穩了：切換 app 不會再自己消失，單次語音輸入延長到 10 分鐘。
zh-Hant.also: 連線中斷時已經講的內容照樣貼上；上一段講完 30 秒內再講不用跳回 Parley。

en.title: Tap the text to copy it
en.body: After dictating, tap the text to copy all of it, and the keyboard confirms with “✓ Copied”. The keyboard is steadier too: it no longer disappears after app switches, and a dictation can run for 10 minutes.
en.also: If the connection drops, what you said is still typed, and you can dictate again within 30 seconds without leaving the app you're in.
